description: A dramatic painted crowd of rural, mostly dark-skinned peasants marches up a stony mountain path under a stormy sky. A central man in a dark ragged poncho and wide-brimmed hat raises a long spear and holds a machete. Behind him, hundreds more carry pikes, machetes and a few muskets, with women in long skirts and straw hats. A colonial-style town with a church sits in the valley below. Era cues are pre-industrial: straw hats, ponchos, linen shirts, spears and muskets. No text, no frame, no blood.
